clues: This town is the seat of its district, in the north-west of its land. It was once the chief town of a whole realm of lakes.
The wet time here comes in July, heralded by dust and thunder storms. It turns the dry land green in a rush.
A king set this town up in 1559, when his old chief town fell under siege. He moved his seat here, by the lakes.
Folk call this the Town of Lakes, for five great made lakes ring it. Its shore paths are a famed sight of the west.
This town stayed the chief town of its realm for ages, till the year 1818. Then it passed under a far-off crown's sway.
